biotools.summary: SPINNA (Single-Protein Investigation via Nearest-Neighbor Analysis) is a framework for spatial and stoichiometric in situ analysis of biomolecular oligomerization at single-protein resolution. It allows comparison of experimental data with simulations and provides an open-source Python implementation and GUI.
